title: Custom Ecnhants
description: This plugin adds 30 new enchantments that are unique in their own way, from the usual auto melter to the crusher, some enchantments have their own level.
body:
CustomEnchant is a lightweight and high-performance plugin that adds a wide variety of unique custom enchantments for tools, weapons, and armor.
The plugin is fully compatible with Anvil (you can combine enchantments) and features a convenient give command.
Main Enchantments
🔥 Smelt — Automatically smelts ores when mining (Silk Touch + Furnace hybrid)
⛏ Drill — Mines a 3×3 (or larger) area in one hit
🧲 Magnet — All dropped items are automatically pulled to you
🌲 Timber — Instantly chops down entire trees
🌾 Farmer — Automatically harvests crops and replants them
⚔ Executioner / Reaper / Grizzly — Powerful combat enchantments
💰 Exp — Increased experience drop
🏠 Alarm — Base protection (notifies you when blocks are broken)
🔄 Tele — Teleportation under certain conditions
🔥 Fever — Speed buff after kills
🪨 Crusher, 🧲 Puller, 🌀 Manasteal and many others
Features
Full Anvil support (combining enchantments)
Customizable enchantment levels
Beautiful colored enchantment names in item lore
Lightweight and highly optimized code
/cegive command for administrators
Commands
/cegive <smelt|drill|magnet|timber|farmer|...> [level] — give an item with the specified enchantment
Permission: customenchant.admin
Who It's For
Perfect for Survival, RPG, SkyBlock, Anarchy, and any other servers where you want to make grinding more interesting and enjoyable.
